body.p: There was once a young pygmy whose name was Mambalia. His relations kept whipping and whipping him until at last he could bear it no more and ran away into the forest. His family followed him, but he built a huge fire and said, "I am not going back - ever!" And he ran even further away. His relations returned to their camp. After that, whenever Mambalia heard voices he ran further away still, until finally he said, "Now this is my part of the forest, and nobody must come here. I'm going to stay here all by myself." He lived in a hole in a tree where no one could find him. He became very, very powerful. He became a satani. And now he is an old, old man. Basi ['That is all'].
